data.title: software/: generate index.html + style.css from BRANDING.md (brand-page); unbreak node build.js at bucket 700

data.body:
Review (self-review: sub-agent spawning is disabled in this session, so the fresh-context review gate could not be honoured — flagging rather than claiming an independent review).

Reviewed software/index.html (78 lines) + software/style.css (~470 lines) against the plan and BRANDING.md.

VERIFIED BY EXECUTION, not by reading:
- node build.js succeeds; was red before ('no <body> found in software/index.html'). 12 sites compiled.
- Brief s9 scripted tests, run in headless Chrome over all 37 elements of #site-software in the BUILT page: BAD RADIUS none (every computed corner is 0px or 50%); NON-INSET SHADOW none outside the allow-listed .sw-plate registration offset; BLUR none; TEXT-SHADOW none; H-SCROLL no; V-SCROLL no; sleeve 674px inside a 733px viewport; 3 focusable links.
- Standalone /software/index.html and the built root index.html render byte-identical at 780x900 (same md5) — the CSS scoping transform is lossless here.
- prefers-reduced-motion: the scan reveal lands on the finished frame (plate fully rendered), not frame zero. Confirmed by screenshot with --force-prefers-reduced-motion.
- Checked at 740x820, 700x560 (short viewport) and 780x900. The cqi sizing holds the composition together at all three; nothing overflows.

BUG FOUND AND FIXED DURING IMPLEMENTATION:
'.sw-type p { margin: 0 }' (specificity 0,1,1) was silently overriding margin-top on .sw-middot / .sw-edition / .sw-caption (0,1,0), so the type column's entire vertical rhythm was dead — it rendered as a tight clump. Removed the blanket rule and folded margin into each class's shorthand. This is exactly the failure the brief's s6 vertical rhythm spec exists to prevent, and it was invisible without a screenshot.

CONTRACT COMPLIANCE (root CLAUDE.md): single @import first, ';' as %3B; only @import/@media/@keyframes allowed at-rules used; no head <link> to a font; ids prefixed (software-tooth-f) and keyframes prefixed (software-light, software-scan); isolation: isolate on body; no position: fixed; no display on html/body; html+body agree on every shared property; no local assets so no url() rewriting needed; no literal </style>.

DELIBERATE DEVIATIONS, both recorded in the plan:
1. Separate index.html + style.css rather than the brand-page skill's 'inline everything' — build.js REQUIRES <name>/style.css, and siblings vhs/ and liquid/ are already split. The skill text predates the build step.
2. Brief-internal conflict: s4 sets the list in --ink, s7's hover says --ink-2 -> --ink. Followed s4 (better contrast); hover carries weight 400->500 plus the centre-out hairline only.
3. s9's tail caption dropped, as s9 itself instructs when there is nothing real to link. The role line moved into the label mark as SOFTWARE-DEVELOPER, keeping the hyphenated-compound tic.

Scope: software/index.html, software/style.css (both new) and the rebuilt root index.html. sites.config.json remains another agent's uncommitted change, untouched.

Meets acceptance criteria.
